# CareGap

> CareGap is healthcare infrastructure that lets companies order Quest Diagnostics
> lab tests from their own application through a single API, on HIPAA-compliant
> rails, with published pricing and no sales call required.

## What CareGap solves

Companies building telehealth, wellness, longevity, peptide and GLP-1 products
routinely need lab testing and discover late that they need three things they do
not have: a Quest Diagnostics account, a licensed ordering provider with an NPI,
and a HIPAA-compliant place for the patient record to live. CareGap already runs
a live Quest interface and provides all three as one product under one contract.

## Pricing (public)

- $1,500 one-time setup fee
- $2.00 per lab order placed (flat, never a percentage of the test price)
- $1.00 per patient record per year
- The lab test itself is billed separately by Quest to the customer's account,
  at CareGap account rates rather than Quest published list price.

## Requirements before ordering

- A licensed ordering provider with an NPI. CareGap never originates the order
  and this is not direct-access testing.
- Cash pay, billed to the customer's account. Insurance billing is not supported.
- Declared states of practice. Roughly half of US states regulate re-billing lab
  work through direct-bill, anti-markup, or disclosure statutes.
- A HIPAA-compliant patient record, which is included.

## Timeline

Sandbox access is available in minutes. Production typically takes several
business days, because issuing a Quest account is a manual process on Quest's
side. The integration can be built while that paperwork clears.

## Two ways to buy

- Self-serve: the customer has a development team and integrates against the API
  directly. Sign up, pay, integrate, no meeting required.
- Managed: the customer has the clinical model but not the engineering team, and
  the CareGap build team ships and maintains the application for them.

## Two ways to order Quest tests

- On CareGap's Quest account (https://caregap.io/lab-ordering): no Quest account
  of your own and no setup fee. Testing is charged at CareGap's Testing Price
  List plus a per-order platform fee of $5.00 for orders 1-100 in a month, $3.00
  for 101-500 and $2.00 above 500, both at submission. Sandbox in minutes with
  no card; production once the entity is verified, a payment method is on file
  and one ordering provider is enrolled. API docs: https://app.caregap.io/docs,
  for agents https://app.caregap.io/llms.txt.
- On your own Quest account (https://caregap.io/quest): the pricing above.
